Product Features

  • Contemporary headboard in panel shape: The bed and headboard are upholstered in grey linen fabric to give a warm and comfortable feeling, and the design panel of the headboard with grill matches the warm, rustic style of your home.
  • Charging dock on Wingback: We've also added USB+Type-C charging ports to the sides of the headboard, allowing you to charge your smartphones, tablets and other electronic devices or charge them directly at your bedside. You no longer have to get up to charge your devices, saving you time and energy.
  • Skin-friendly material Fully upholstered in linen, the grey bed is a fantastic addition that is comfortable to the touch. The padded headboard provides a comfortable place to rest in bed.
  • Rugged craftsmanship: Crafted with precision and durability in mind, the bed features a sturdy structure that guarantees stability and longevity. Our attention to detail ensures a reliable and secure foundation that supports you in style and substance.
  • Efficient assembly The bed is delivered flat packed and can be assembled by yourself. DIYers don't need to worry because the innovative design makes it easy to set up, especially when coupled with the clear and comprehensive instructions that come with every purchase and are also available online.
